title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police report results of a speed control week (13–19 April 2026) at 203 locations, recording 6,732 speeding violations, 58 of them over 31 km/h above the limit. Police also reported 341 other traffic offences and 49 criminal offences.
